title: Aug 26 Results + Aug 27 Preview: When 73% Feels Like a Victory Lap

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Momentum

Some days, the model just *gets it*. Yesterday was one of those days where we went 11-4, hitting 73.3% of our picks, and honestly? It felt good. Real good. The kind of day where you can feel the rhythm of the season clicking into place, where the numbers and the narratives align just right.

## The Wins That Mattered

Let's talk about what went right. The Padres pick at 68% confidence? Chef's kiss. The Guardians taking care of business against the Angels exactly as predicted. The Phillies traveling to Seattle and doing what we thought they'd do. These weren't just wins—they were validations of the process.

The Yankees-Astros game was particularly sweet. A 50-50 coin flip that we called correctly. Sometimes it's not about the confidence percentage—it's about trusting your read on the moment.

## The Misses We're Learning From

Now, about those four losses. The Tigers couldn't pull through against the Rays in what was essentially a toss-up at 51%. The Sox-Marlins miss stung a bit more at 61% confidence—that's one we thought we had a solid read on. And the Nationals? Another close call at 51% that didn't go our way.

But here's the thing about misses: they're part of the story. Baseball is beautiful because it's unpredictable. A 73% hit rate means we're reading the game well, but it also means we're humble enough to know we won't get them all.

## Tomorrow's Story: Rockies at Nationals, Round Two

Speaking of the Nationals—we're going back to that well. Tomorrow's top pick is Washington hosting Colorado again, and yes, it's another 50-50 scenario. But after watching how these teams matched up, there's something in the pitching matchup that speaks to us.

Gabriel Hughes takes the mound for the Rockies against Jake Irvin for Washington. The Nationals are at home, and sometimes that's enough of an edge when everything else is equal.

## The Bottom Line

We're riding high after yesterday's 11-4 performance, but we're staying grounded. Tomorrow brings a fresh slate, a new chance to read the game, and another opportunity to trust the process. The Nationals pick might not inspire wild confidence at 50%, but sometimes the best stories come from the games that could go either way.

That's baseball. That's why we love it.

Let's go get another win. 🎯
